exposure: Demelin's maneuver for arm entrapment during vaginal breech delivery
outcome: Success of Demelin's maneuver without neonatal trauma
cohort: The study included 29 live newborns delivered vaginally in breech presentation after 32 weeks of gestation who required Demelin's maneuver for persistent arm entrapment after the Lovset maneuver had failed.
finding: Demelin's maneuver showed an 82.8% success rate without related neonatal trauma and appears to be an effective and safe method for treating arm entrapment dystocia during vaginal breech delivery after failure of the Lovset maneuver.
mod_finding: Demelin's maneuver, performed during vaginal breech deliveries, was found to be an effective and safe method for treating arm entrapment dystocia.
gest_age: After 32 weeks of gestation (inclusion criterion), 38 ± 2.4 weeks of gestation (mean)
